_comment: Tier A answer keys (ADR 0079), authored BEFORE the build. The interpreter/embedder are INJECTED in tests (CI never calls a model); the live console wires gpt-4o-mini + text-embedding-3-small. Families: ground (tiered resolution), connect (the subgraph speaks), steer (display modes are buttons), remember (the interpretation ledger), law (never-regex census).

ground.title: exact tiers stay model-free
expected: a mention equal to a folded name or identity grounds WITHOUT any embed call (deterministic tiers first)

ground.title: semantic tier grounds by meaning
expected: mention 'blood infection reports' grounds to sepsis-named files via vector similarity over meaning text
scores visible; below-threshold -> HITL candidates, never a guess

ground.title: kind words ground to kind-sets
expected: mention 'reports' grounds to the file KIND via Kind_Vocabulary (registry data), enabling kind+topic questions

ground.title: embeddings are stamped and cached
expected: each stored vector carries (entry identity, text hash, model); an unchanged meaning never re-embeds across builds

connect.title: two mentions -> the connecting path speaks
connect.question: how does DATE_STAMP relate to USP_ED_SEPSIS
expected: a path from the drift/derived name to the file, each hop labeled, each node speaking one meaning line

connect.title: kind+topic -> the filtered set (live find #4 dies)
connect.question: what reports are about sepsis
expected: files matching the topic listed with scores — the question that exposed the enumeration disease now answers

connect.title: single mention -> the neighborhood
connect.question: THERA_CLASS_CODE
expected: the node's card plus its typed neighborhood (its table; scopes citing it), caps visible

steer.title: display modes are buttons, not classified intents
expected: a grounded answer offers card/lineage/filters/readers re-renders; no model ever chooses among them

remember.title: confirm -> ledger -> no model on repeat
expected: a confirmed interpretation lands as a 'confirmed' usage event with the interpretation payload and model basis
the same folded question later NEVER calls the interpreter; the interpretation re-executes against the CURRENT graph

remember.title: interpretation cached, never the answer
expected: a graph change between asks changes the ANSWER of a ledger-hit question

law.title: never-regex census
expected: no regex is applied to question text anywhere in aivia/ (the grammar is DELETED, not bypassed); mechanical string-tool regex remains legal

seat.title: an exploding interpreter is an outcome, not a crash
expected: interpret_fn raising ANY exception -> status seat_down-degraded answer path, deterministic tiers still answer, the failure counted

seat.title: an exploding embedder degrades the semantic tier only
expected: semantic.search failure -> grounding falls back to deterministic tiers + HITL, never a dead page

seat.title: deterministic asks are immune to model weather
expected: exact-name and kind questions answer normally while both seats are down
